json_proto.semanticYaml:
name: VIBRATION_MANAGEMENT
description: Predictive Maintenance & OEE Command Center semantic model for a multi-plant
  vibration management system. Covers equipment health monitoring (bearing health
  scores, ISO 10816 vibration severity, ADR risk classification), OEE metrics (Availability,
  Performance, Quality), maintenance ticket lifecycle (MTTR, SLA compliance), vibration
  alerts, and cross-plant executive dashboards. Equipment types include Motors, Compressors,
  Blowers, Pumps, and Fans across 3 chemical/polymer/pharma plants. Uses process-industry
  naming conventions (MTR 510 A, COMP 520 C, etc.).

verified_queries:
  - name: 0;1
    question: What is the overview of all plants ranked by equipment health performance?
    sql: SELECT PLANT_NAME, TOTAL_ASSETS, AVG_HEALTH_SCORE, AVG_OEE_30D, OPEN_TICKETS,
      ACTIVE_ALERTS FROM dt_plant_dashboard ORDER BY AVG_HEALTH_SCORE
    verified_at: 1789734674
    verified_by: Semantic Model Generator
  - name: 1;1
    question: Which assets are at risk and what are their health metrics?
    sql: SELECT ASSET_NAME, PLANT_NAME, BEARING_HEALTH_SCORE, ADR_RISK, PEAK_VEL_RMS,
      MAX_TEMPERATURE_C FROM dt_bearing_health WHERE ADR_RISK <> 'LOW_RISK' ORDER
      BY BEARING_HEALTH_SCORE
    verified_at: 1789734674
    verified_by: Semantic Model Generator
  - name: 2;1
    question: What are all the actionable vibration alerts that require attention?
    sql: SELECT ASSET_NAME, PLANT_NAME, ALERT_SEVERITY, RECOMMENDED_ACTION, BEARING_HEALTH_SCORE
      FROM dt_vibration_alerts WHERE IS_ACTIONABLE = TRUE ORDER BY ALERT_SEVERITY
    verified_at: 1789734674
    verified_by: Semantic Model Generator
  - name: 3;1
    question: What is the average OEE performance by plant and production line over
      the last 30 days?
    sql: SELECT PLANT_NAME, PRODUCTION_LINE, AVG(OEE) AS AVG_OEE, AVG(AVAILABILITY)
      AS AVG_AVAIL, AVG(PERFORMANCE) AS AVG_PERF, AVG(QUALITY) AS AVG_QUAL FROM dt_oee_metrics
      WHERE RUN_DATE >= DATEADD(DAY, -30, CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY PLANT_NAME, PRODUCTION_LINE
      ORDER BY AVG_OEE
    verified_at: 1789734674
    verified_by: Semantic Model Generator
  - name: 4;1
    question: What are the open maintenance tickets?
    sql: SELECT TICKET_ID, ASSET_NAME, PLANT_NAME, SEVERITY, STATUS, ISSUE_OPEN_DATE,
      CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS_REC, TICKET_AGE_DAYS FROM dt_maintenance_history WHERE STATUS
      <> 'CLOSED' ORDER BY SEVERITY DESC, ISSUE_OPEN_DATE
    verified_at: 1789734674
    verified_by: Semantic Model Generator
  - name: 5;1
    question: Which are the 10 worst health assets?
    sql: SELECT ASSET_NAME, PLANT_NAME, BEARING_HEALTH_SCORE, PEAK_VEL_RMS, PEAK_RSS_ACCEL,
      MAX_TEMPERATURE_C, WORST_ISO_ZONE FROM dt_bearing_health ORDER BY BEARING_HEALTH_SCORE
      ASC LIMIT 10
    verified_at: 1789734674
    verified_by: Semantic Model Generator
  - name: 6;1
    question: What are the maintenance ticket trends by plant and month?
    sql: SELECT PLANT_NAME, MONTH, TOTAL_TICKETS, AVG_MTTR_HOURS, TOTAL_DOWNTIME_HOURS,
      BEARING_DEFECT_COUNT, MISALIGNMENT_COUNT, UNBALANCE_COUNT FROM dt_ticket_analytics
      ORDER BY PLANT_NAME, MONTH
    verified_at: 1789734674
    verified_by: Semantic Model Generator
  - name: 7;1
    question: What are the most common failure modes and their average repair time?
    sql: SELECT FAILURE_MODE, COUNT(*) AS INCIDENT_COUNT, AVG(MTTR_HOURS) AS AVG_MTTR,
      SUM(DOWNTIME_HOURS) AS TOTAL_DOWNTIME FROM dt_maintenance_history WHERE NOT
      FAILURE_MODE IS NULL GROUP BY FAILURE_MODE ORDER BY INCIDENT_COUNT DESC
    verified_at: 1789734674
    verified_by: Semantic Model Generator
